React Developer

Engineering Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India Full-time

Build well designed, testable React interfaces from client requirements, and deliver them on the dates the team committed to.

01
The role

Posted 09-Sep-2026. Open until it is filled.

A front end development seat. You work from client requirements and functional specifications, write code that the next person can read and test, and deliver quality projects inside the timelines the team agreed with the client. The role expects you to keep learning: new tools and libraries get evaluated properly rather than adopted on reputation.

Apply for this role

02
Responsibilities

React Developer responsibilities

  • Understand client requirements and functional specifications.
  • Write well designed, testable, efficient code.
  • Ensure quality projects are delivered within defined timelines.
  • Adhere to industry best practices and contribute to internal coding standards.
  • Communicate with the customer as and when required.
  • Learn and evaluate new technologies and tools as needed.
03
Requirements

React Developer requirements

  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript.
  • Good knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3.
  • Understanding of JavaScript libraries and frameworks, including ReactJS.
  • Working knowledge of Flux architecture (Redux).
  • Good knowledge of TypeScript and ES6.
  • Proficient understanding of React-Bootstrap.
  • Deep knowledge of ReactJS practices and commonly used modules, based on extensive work experience.
